high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of a person's hand holding an iPhone with the ChatGPT interface displayed on the screen. The phone is encased in a gold-colored protective cover. The screen displays the ChatGPT website, specifically the "Examples" section, which includes three example queries: "Explain quantum computing in simple terms" "Got any creative ideas for a 10 year old's birthday?" "How do I make an HTTP request in JavaScript?" Below these examples, there is a section labeled "Capabilities," which mentions that ChatGPT remembers what the user said earlier in the conversation.
